'''2019 Worlds Day 2 Casper Jørgensen LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casper Jørgensen]] at [[2019 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Casper Jørgensen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|V9-L-theyhavenoideawerecoming.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127130309/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ Internet Archive]
